subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/zswap: batch the writeback IO of consecutive entries

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the writeback I/O of zswap by batching consecutive entries into a single bio, reducing the number of I/O requests and improving performance. The patch introduces a new struct to share state between all entries written back in one LRU walk, allowing for more efficient use of I/O resources. The changes are based on measurements that show significant improvements in build time, write requests, pages per write request, iocost debt, and IO full pressure when batching is enabled.
